difficulty_reason: The lemma compares $S$-rational maps from a scheme with finitely many irreducible components to a scheme over $S$ with the data consisting, at each generic point, of a point of the target over the image of that generic point together with a local pullback map of local rings; it asserts injectivity when the target is locally of finite type, bijectivity when it is locally of finite presentation, and bijectivity in the locally finite type case when the source is reduced. The proof restricts the source to a dense open making it the disjoint union of its finitely many irreducible components and factors the correspondence as a product over the components, reducing to an irreducible source, where the three assertions are those of the already established local description of rational maps by their local behaviour.
